DatabaseAccess.description: DatabaseAccess may be None, Full or Restrict. If you choose Restrict, provide ';'-separated trees list, where database files are stored.

RemoteAccess.description: Ability to access databases remotely. May be true or false (1/0, Yes/No).

ExternalFileAccess.description: External File Paths/Directories. May be None, Full or Restrict.

UdfAccess.description: External Function (UDF) Paths/Directories. May be None, Full or Restrict.

TempTableDirectory.description: Directory to put data of temporary tables and blobs.

AuditTraceConfigFile.description: Trace configuration file for system audit.

MaxUserTraceLogSize.description: Maximum summary size of each user trace session's log files in MB.

DatabaseGrowthIncrement.description: Disk space preallocation. Amount of preallocated disk space in bytes.

UseFileSystemCache.description: File system cache usage. Determines whether Firebird will use file system cache.

FileSystemCacheThreshold.description: File system cache threshold. Measured in database pages.

FileSystemCacheSize.description: File system cache size. Measured in % of total physical RAM.

RemoteFileOpenAbility.description: Remove protection against opening databases on NFS mounted volumes.

TempBlockSize.description: Smallest block size being allocated in the temporary storage.

TempCacheLimit.description: The maximum amount of the temporary space that can be cached in memory.

MaxIdentifierByteLength.description: Maximum allowed identifier name length in bytes.

MaxIdentifierCharLength.description: Maximum allowed identifier name length in characters.

InlineSortThreshold.description: Threshold that controls whether to store non-key fields inside the sort block.

AuthServer.description: AuthServer determines which authentication methods will be used by network server.

AuthClient.description: AuthClient determines which authentication methods will be used by client redirector.

UserManager.description: UserManager sets plugin used to work with security database.

TracePlugin.description: TracePlugin is used by firebird trace facility.

WireCryptPlugin.description: Wire crypt plugins are used to crypt data transferred over the wire.

KeyHolderPlugin.description: Key holder is a kind of temp storage for DB crypt keys.

AllowEncryptedSecurityDatabase.description: Ability to use encrypted security database.

Providers.description: Determines what providers will be used by firebird.

DeadlockTimeout.description: Number of seconds that the lock manager will wait after a conflict has been encountered before purging locks from dead processes.

StatementTimeout.description: Number of seconds after which statement execution will be automatically cancelled by the engine.

ConnectionIdleTimeout.description: Number of minutes after which idle attachment will be disconnected by the engine.

OnDisconnectTriggerTimeout.description: Number of seconds after which ON DISCONNECT trigger execution will be automatically cancelled by the engine.

MaxUnflushedWrites.description: Number of unflushed writes which will accumulate before they are flushed.

MaxUnflushedWriteTime.description: Number of seconds during which unflushed writes will accumulate before they are flushed.

BugcheckAbort.description: Controls whether to call abort() when internal error or BUGCHECK is encountered.

ClearGTTAtRetaining.description: How COMMIT\ROLLBACK RETAINING handle GLOBAL TEMPORARY TABLE ON COMMIT DELETE ROWS.

RelaxedAliasChecking.description: Relaxing relation alias checking rules in SQL.

ReadConsistency.description: Engine currently provides statement-level read consistency in READ COMMITTED mode by default.

DataTypeCompatibility.description: Minor FB version datatype compatibility with which you need.

ConnectionTimeout.description: Seconds to wait before concluding an attempt to connect has failed.

WireCrypt.description: Should connection over the wire be encrypted? Required, Enabled or Disabled.

WireCompression.description: Should connection over the wire be compressed?

DummyPacketInterval.description: Seconds to wait on a silent client connection before the server sends dummy packets to request acknowledgment.

ClientBatchBuffer.description: Buffer size (in bytes) used by the client connection to accumulate output messages before sending them to the server using Batch API.

DefaultTimeZone.description: Default session or client time zone.

RemoteServiceName.description: The TCP Service name/Port number to be used for client database connections.

RemoteServicePort.description: The TCP Port number to be used for client database connections.

RemoteAuxPort.description: The TCP Port Number to be used for server Event Notification messages.

TcpRemoteBufferSize.description: TCP/IP buffer size for send and receive buffers of both the client and server.

TcpNoNagle.description: Either enables or disables Nagle algorithm (TCP_NODELAY option of socket).

TcpLoopbackFastPath.description: Either enables or disables the TCP Loopback Fast Path feature.

IPv6V6Only.description: Allows setting of IPV6_V6ONLY socket option.

RemoteBindAddress.description: Allows incoming connections to be bound to the IP address of a specific network card.

LockMemSize.description: Bytes of shared memory allocated for lock manager.

LockAcquireSpins.description: Number of attempts that will be made conditionally to acquire the lock table mutex.

LockHashSlots.description: Tune lock hash list; more hash slots mean shorter hash chains.

EventMemSize.description: Bytes of shared memory allocated for event manager.

SnapshotsMemSize.description: Bytes of shared memory allocated for snapshots management.

TipCacheBlockSize.description: Bytes of shared memory allocated for each block of TIP cache.

OutputRedirectionFile.description: File to redirect stdout and stderr output of server.

CpuAffinityMask.description: Which CPUs should be used (Windows Only).

GCPolicy.description: Garbage collection policy. Valid values are: cooperative, background, combined.

GuardianOption.description: Does the guardian restart the server every time it crashes? 0 - only start once, 1 - always restart.

ProcessPriorityLevel.description: Priority level/class for the server process.

IpcName.description: The name of the shared memory area used as a transport channel in local protocol.

RemotePipeName.description: The name of the pipe used as a transport channel in NetBEUI protocol.

UseLegacyKernelObjectsNames.description: The way of how to create names for named Windows kernel objects.

Redirection.description: Remove protection against redirecting requests to other servers.

ServerMode.description: Controls the method Firebird engine uses to work with databases. Super, SuperClassic, Classic.

ExtConnPoolSize.description: Set the maximum number of inactive (idle) external connections to retain at the pool.

ExtConnPoolLifeTime.description: Set the time before destroyng inactive external connection, seconds.
